full_page.content:
1933, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
.... To pay just debts .... Employment.
Lois Marie Clancy - 16 mo. brain injured - at -birth - beautiful child .. but ...
Jos. Norman - 69 cancer of jaw - 2 operations fears 3rd.
Mable Brown -- 59 - non C. - cancer under eye - back from Mayo Brs . . . Hopeless.
Mrs. Eddington - Mother of E. Mulcare.
Helen Gurgevich - non c. - 23 - T.B. in Kiefer Hosp.
John J. Clarke - 60 - with wife & sons, lost property, etc. Now starting anew, hopes to be able to pay honest debts ....
Mary Mccarthy - 18 - (Montclare) wayward - enrolled several times as annual, put in home of Good Shepherd and let out again - now a- way 5 weeks - no one knows where - is enrolled once more, mother promising perpetual enrollment if she be found and do better.
Mrs. M. C. Hogan - "middle-aged" - housekeeper or anything - 3 sons married, but out of work. 3113 Crane Ave.
Mrs. M. Centeck - 52 - cancer internal
Loraine Barzykowski - 4 - ....
Seriously unjust court-case. . . Threatened. Gloria Best - 3 - Eyes .... Father unbeliever Mrs. Fix - 26 - mental.
Page 128 Page 129 July
Blank Page.
Muriel Anderson - 28 - "fainted" last Wed.
Henry Laethem - 57 - Rochester Sanitarium - nervous break-down, refuses to eat.
Mrs. Hall - 53 - cancer of breast - operation in Ann Arbor . ... anxious.
Christine Geraghty - Windsor - and sister - given up 15 months ago with T.B. Home now but quite ailing.
Page 127 July
